title: Vickers Wellington R1461
memorial_details: description: BWLCH-Y-RHIW FARMHOUSE/ At 0146 Hrs on 26th January 1943, a Wellington Aircraft, R1461, on a training exercise from/ R.A.F. Harwell, Berkshire, crashed on this house/ causing the deaths of/ EDWIN WILLIAMS, his wife ANNIE JANE/ and the entire crew of the aircraft/ (NAMES)
